claim: In the matching retail DLL, MatchMisc.GetHealth (0x0600495C) is a static one-Float32-parameter method returning Int32, with parameter name prm and an exact 204-byte body. It contains no calls and implements a 15-step ordered threshold ladder. At each rung it loads prm, loads the next Float32 threshold 4096, 8192, 12288, 16384, 20480, 24576, 28672, 32768, 36864, 40960, 45056, 49152, 53248, 57344, or 61440, then uses bge.un to continue to the next rung; otherwise it returns the corresponding raw integer 0 through 14. If all 15 branches continue, it returns raw integer 15. FACT-0021 pins six CalcDamage calls to this helper and FACT-0022 pins one CriticalCheck call.
